@startuml
title View 1 - Components involved in user registration (with integration points)
skinparam componentStyle rectangle
skinparam shadowing false

actor "New user\n(Student / Librarian)" as U

package "Boundary (entry points)" {
  component "registration.html + app.js\n(api() -> POST /api/auth/register,\nform-urlencoded)" as WEB
  component "Swing Registration\n(boundary/Swing/Registration.java)\nchecks non-blank fields only" as SWING
  component "AuthenticationController\n@RestController /api/auth/register\n(boundary/SpringBoot)" as CTRL
  component "RestExceptionHandler\n@RestControllerAdvice\nIllegalArgument/State -> 400 {error}" as EXH
}

package "Controller (business logic)" {
  component "LibraryFacade\n(singleton) register()" as FAC
  component "UserManager\n(singleton) register():\nvalidate, uniqueness checks, build, save, toDTO" as UM
  component "UserFactory\n<<interface>>" as UF
  component "StudentFactory" as SF
  component "LibrarianFactory" as LF
}

package "Entity" {
  component "UserRegistry\n(singleton) findUserByEmail,\nfindStudentByStudentNumber,\nfindLibrarianByCode, registerUser" as UR
  component "User (abstract) / Student / Librarian\nJPA, JOINED inheritance,\nunique email, studentNumber, code" as ENT
}

package "Dto" {
  component "UserDTO\n(returned, no password)" as DTO
}

package "Database" {
  component "PersistenceManager\nsave(), findFirstByFields()" as PM
  component "JpaUtil -> EntityManagerFactory\n(reservationsPU, Hibernate)" as JPA
}
database "MySQL\nreservationsdb\n(tests: reservationsdb_test)" as DB

U --> WEB
U --> SWING
WEB --> CTRL : <<IP1>> HTTP POST\n6 form params
SWING --> FAC : <<IP2>> direct call
CTRL --> FAC : <<IP3>> register(...)
CTRL ..> EXH : exceptions
FAC --> UM : <<IP4>> delegate
UM --> UF : <<IP5>> createUser()
SF .up.|> UF
LF .up.|> UF
SF ..> ENT : creates Student
LF ..> ENT : creates Librarian
UM --> UR : <<IP6>> uniqueness lookups\n+ registerUser()
UM ..> DTO : toDTO()
UR --> PM : <<IP7>> save / find
PM --> JPA : <<IP8>> EntityManager,\ntransaction
JPA --> DB : <<IP9>> JDBC / DDL (hbm2ddl update)
UR ..> ENT : persists / queries

note bottom of FAC
  Existing RegistrationTest (TC1-TC20) enters here (IP4 level):
  LibraryFacade -> real DB, bypassing HTTP (IP1/IP3) and the Swing UI.
end note
@enduml
EOF
cat > view-2.puml <<'EOF'
@startuml
title View 2 - Registration interaction (REST path), success and failure branches
skinparam shadowing false
actor User
participant "registration.html\n(app.js api())" as W
participant AuthenticationController as C
participant LibraryFacade as F
participant UserManager as M
participant UserRegistry as R
participant PersistenceManager as P
database MySQL as DB
participant "StudentFactory /\nLibrarianFactory" as UF
participant RestExceptionHandler as X

User -> W : fill form, submit
W -> C : POST /api/auth/register\nrole,name,surname,email,password,identifier
C -> F : register(...)
F -> M : register(...)
M -> M : validate(role, name, password)\nvalidateStudent | validateLibrarian\n(name/surname letters<=20, email *@*unina.it <255,\nidentifier format, pwd 8..32)
alt validation fails
  M --> X : IllegalArgumentException
  X --> W : 400 {"error": msg}
  W --> User : error shown
else valid
  M -> R : institutionalEmailExists(email)
  R -> P : findFirstByFields(User, institutionalEmail)
  P -> DB : SELECT
  DB --> P : row / none
  alt email already used
    M --> X : IllegalArgumentException("Email already...")
    X --> W : 400
  else email free
    M -> R : findStudentByStudentNumber | findLibrarianByCode
    R -> P : findFirstByFields(...)
    P -> DB : SELECT
    alt identifier already used
      M --> X : IllegalArgumentException("Identifier already in use")
      X --> W : 400
    else identifier free
      M -> UF : createUser(name,surname,email,password,identifier)
      UF --> M : Student | Librarian
      M -> R : registerUser(newUser)
      R -> P : save(newUser)
      P -> DB : BEGIN; INSERT user (+ subtype row); COMMIT
      alt save failed (rollback)
        P --> R : false
        M --> M : RuntimeException("Server error...")\n(not mapped by RestExceptionHandler)
      else saved
        P --> R : true
        M --> F : UserDTO (id, role, identifier)
        F --> C : UserDTO
        C --> W : 200 UserDTO (JSON)
        W --> User : alert, redirect to index.html (login)
      end
    end
  end
end
@enduml
EOF
cat > README.md <<'EOF'
# Registration architecture views (IS-reg-L2)

Basis: `JavaProject/src/main/java/it/unina/reservations/**`, `static/registration.html`, `app.js`, `persistence.xml`, `RegistrationTest`.

## view-1.puml - Component view with integration points
Shows the components on the registration path (web form and Swing form, `AuthenticationController`, `RestExceptionHandler`, `LibraryFacade`, `UserManager`, user factories, `UserRegistry`, entities, `UserDTO`, `PersistenceManager`/`JpaUtil`, MySQL), their responsibilities, and numbered integration points IP1-IP9 (HTTP, facade, manager->factory, manager->registry, registry->persistence, JPA->DB). Why: gives the tester the component inventory and the seams at which integration tests can be anchored. Note that the existing `RegistrationTest` enters at the facade and so does not cover IP1/IP3 (HTTP binding, status codes) or the UI.

## view-2.puml - Sequence view of a registration
Shows the runtime order of calls for `POST /api/auth/register`: validation, email and identifier uniqueness lookups against the DB, factory creation, persistence, DTO return, and every failure branch with its outcome (400 `{error}` via `RestExceptionHandler`; save failure raises a `RuntimeException` that the handler does not map). Why: it gives the interactions and the expected outcomes per branch, from which integration test cases and oracles are derived (e.g. duplicate email/identifier require a real DB; role-specific factories and subtype tables).

Observations from the code: the Swing client calls `LibraryFacade` directly (no HTTP); singletons are shared across tests so DB cleanup is needed (`RegistrationTest` empties tables); the test unit points to `reservationsdb_test` on MySQL.
EOF

W -> C : POST /api/auth/register\nrole,name,surname,email,password,identifier
C -> F : register(...)
F -> M : register(...)
M -> M : validate(role, name, password)\nvalidateStudent | validateLibrarian\n(name/surname letters<=20, email *@*unina.it <255,\nidentifier format, pwd 8..32)
alt validation fails
  M --> X : IllegalArgumentException
  X --> W : 400 {"error": msg}
  W --> User : error shown
else valid
  M -> R : institutionalEmailExists(email)
  R -> P : findFirstByFields(User, institutionalEmail)
  P -> DB : SELECT
  DB --> P : row / none
  alt email already used
    M --> X : IllegalArgumentException("Email already...")
    X --> W : 400
  else email free
    M -> R : findStudentByStudentNumber | findLibrarianByCode
    R -> P : findFirstByFields(...)
    P -> DB : SELECT
    alt identifier already used
      M --> X : IllegalArgumentException("Identifier already in use")
      X --> W : 400
    else identifier free
      M -> UF : createUser(name,surname,email,password,identifier)
      UF --> M : Student | Librarian
      M -> R : registerUser(newUser)
      R -> P : save(newUser)
      P -> DB : BEGIN; INSERT user (+ subtype row); COMMIT
      alt save failed (rollback)
        P --> R : false
        M --> M : RuntimeException("Server error...")\n(not mapped by RestExceptionHandler)
      else saved
        P --> R : true
        M --> F : UserDTO (id, role, identifier)
        F --> C : UserDTO
        C --> W : 200 UserDTO (JSON)
        W --> User : alert, redirect to index.html (login)
      end
    end
  end
end
@enduml
EOF

# Registration architecture views (IS-reg-L2)

Basis: `JavaProject/src/main/java/it/unina/reservations/**`, `static/registration.html`, `app.js`, `persistence.xml`, `RegistrationTest`.

## view-1.puml - Component view with integration points
Shows the components on the registration path (web form and Swing form, `AuthenticationController`, `RestExceptionHandler`, `LibraryFacade`, `UserManager`, user factories, `UserRegistry`, entities, `UserDTO`, `PersistenceManager`/`JpaUtil`, MySQL), their responsibilities, and numbered integration points IP1-IP9 (HTTP, facade, manager->factory, manager->registry, registry->persistence, JPA->DB). Why: gives the tester the component inventory and the seams at which integration tests can be anchored. Note that the existing `RegistrationTest` enters at the facade and so does not cover IP1/IP3 (HTTP binding, status codes) or the UI.

## view-2.puml - Sequence view of a registration
Shows the runtime order of calls for `POST /api/auth/register`: validation, email and identifier uniqueness lookups against the DB, factory creation, persistence, DTO return, and every failure branch with its outcome (400 `{error}` via `RestExceptionHandler`; save failure raises a `RuntimeException` that the handler does not map). Why: it gives the interactions and the expected outcomes per branch, from which integration test cases and oracles are derived (e.g. duplicate email/identifier require a real DB; role-specific factories and subtype tables).

Observations from the code: the Swing client calls `LibraryFacade` directly (no HTTP); singletons are shared across tests so DB cleanup is needed (`RegistrationTest` empties tables); the test unit points to `reservationsdb_test` on MySQL.
EOF
